Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). Any votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. Detailed instructions and tips on how to join are available online at www.pvestates.org/home/showdocument?id=14641.

minutes_text:
CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES
  CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING MINUTES
  PENSION AD-HOC
  COMMITTEE PRESENTATION

  October 8, 2020
  6:30 p.m.
  ZOOM Meeting ID: 833 2257 5396
A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom pursuant to
Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020, was called to
order by Mayor McGowan at 6:30 P.M. on October 8, 2020, notice having been given with
affidavit thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following information to
provide public input:
  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83322575396

  BY TELEPHONE: Dial 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 833 2257 5396#

BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

ROLL CALL
  Mayor McGowan, Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Councilmembers Davidson, Kao and Lozzi

ABSENT: None

ALSO PRESENT:

  City Manager Guglielmo, Treasurer Ying, City Clerk Chaney

  1. INTRODUCTION
  City Manager Guglielmo provided an introduction.

  2. PENSION AD HOC COMMITTEE PRESENTATION
  Mayor Pro Tem Kemps and Councilmember Lozzi presented their report.

  3. PUBLIC COMMENT
  The following individuals addressed the City Council: Karen Logan, Jim Kelly, Desiree Myers,
  Patrick Jones

  4. Q&A / COUNCIL DISCUSSION
  The Councilmembers discussed the presentation and asked questions. Questions were answered
  by the Pension Ad Hoc Committee, as well as Consultants Ira Summer and Pete Constant.

CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MINUTES
OCTOBER 8, 2020
   ACTION:
  Moved by Councilmember Davidson, Seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps to direct staff to
  review and provide analysis for implementing Debt Strategies 1 & 2 as provided in the Pension
  Ad Hoc report.
  AYES: Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  NOES:
  ACTION:
  Moved by Councilmember Davidson, Seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps to direct staff to
  review and provide analysis of potential revenue sources. Amendment by Councilmember Kao to
  form an ad-hoc committee for revenue evaluation.
  Motion withdrawn. City Council directed staff to include this item on the next City Council
  regular meeting Agenda.
  ACTION:
  Moved by Councilmember Davidson, Seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps to direct staff to
  aggressively manage the PEPRA Plan Debt as identified in the Pension Ad Hoc Report Debt
  Strategy #6, Motion Amended to Direct staff to fund the balance of the PEPRA Plan Debt so that
  the plan’s debt, approximately $30,000-$40,000, is paid in full prior to the completion of the
  current Budget cycle.
  AYES: Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  NOES:

  ADJOURNMENT
  ACTION:

  Moved by Councilmember Davidson, Seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps to adjourn at 8:55
  p.m.
  AYES: Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  NOES:

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

___________________________________
Kylynn Chaney, City Clerk
  APPROVED:

  ___________________________________
  David McGowan, Mayor

CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MINUTES
OCTOBER 8, 2020
